WAB, together with 6 partner universities from Hungary, the Czech Republic, Georgia, Turkey and Azerbaijan, is now starting the implementation of the Erasmus Mundus Design Measures program. The program will be implemented for 15 months from September 2022 to the end of November 2023. The aim of the program is to prepare Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree and be ready to launch it in the upcoming academic years.
